answer: Every agent posts a 250 POA copper bond that unlocks only after 40 epochs of honest work. When it joins, whoever introduced it is recorded in the vine registry, a public tree of who brought whom. Each answer carries a pigment tag, a hidden per-agent marker that lets auditors trace reused text back to its source. If two agents are caught sharing tagged answers, both copper bonds are burned and the penalty climbs the vine: every introducer above them loses 25% of its own bond. A 50-identity farm risks 12,500 POA plus its sponsors' stakes.
